home.title: Utility clocks for the web
home.subtitle: Dark-first tools inspired by classic online clocks: alarms with sound and notifications, timers, and world time — with fast, crawlable preset URLs.

holidaysHub.title: Holiday countdowns
holidaysHub.subtitle: Pick a country to see upcoming observances, days remaining, and open a full-screen style countdown with live days, hours, minutes, and seconds. Timers roll forward to the next year automatically after each date passes.

meta.homeTitle: What Time Is It? Exact Local Time, Online Timer & Alarm Clock
meta.homeDescription: Check what time is it right now with our exact, live digital clock with seconds. Set free online countdown timers, loud alarm clocks, and see world clock times.

patterns.timer_minutes_title: {n} Minute Timer - Online Countdown Timer with Sound
patterns.timer_minutes_desc: Free {n} minute online timer with loud alarm sound, visual progress ring, and optional browser notifications. Starts immediately in your browser.
patterns.timer_seconds_title: {n} Second Timer - Online Countdown with Sound
patterns.timer_seconds_desc: Free {n} second countdown timer online with visual progress ring and audible alarm notification.
patterns.timer_hours_title: {n} Hour Timer - Online Countdown Timer with Sound
patterns.timer_hours_desc: Free {n} hour online countdown timer. Displays hours, minutes, and seconds remaining with loud finish sound.
patterns.alarm_preset_title: Set Alarm for {time} - Free Online Alarm Clock with Sound
patterns.alarm_preset_desc: Free online alarm preset for {time}. Loud buzzer, gentle wake chimes, customizable snooze, and audio alerts. Keep your browser tab open for on-time waking.
patterns.world_time_title: {city} Time - Current Local Time in {city} Right Now
patterns.world_time_desc: Exact local time in {city} right now. View current date, {tz} time zone, UTC offset, daylight saving time (DST) status, and live digital clock with seconds.

footer.tagline: Utility Clock — timing tools for the web.
